policy.final_claim: Winning formation must remain directionally consistent across exactly two primary seeds.
policy.other_axes: Sample, depth, compute and wall-clock judged separately. Favorable sample/depth efficiency may promote a quality tie. No rigid percentage thresholds.
policy.quality: Coherent held-out loss and BPB evidence; paired uncertainty; reject statistically clear task regressions.
policy.uncertainty: Stratified paired held-out bootstrap, paired WikiText rows, paired exact task-item tests with correction across all available raw/normalized metrics, and blocked timing intervals. Two seeds separately check direction; no rigid percentage thresholds.
